model_3.name: MODEL 3
model_3.subTitle: 3D Photopolymer Dental resin for vacuum/pressure thermoforming
model_3.description: Resinwork® Model 3 is an advanced, IPA & water‑washable 3D printing resin engineered specifically for dental thermoforming applications. Designed to deliver high thermal resistance and dimensional accuracy, Model 3 ensures reliable performance under vacuum and pressure forming conditions. Formulated with Resinwork's proprietary Anti‑Stick Surface Chemistry, Model 3 enables effortless removal of thermoformed appliances—such as retainers, aligners, nightguards, and sportguards—without damage. This unique surface release property significantly reduces the risk of breakage and enhances workflow efficiency in dental labs. Unlike conventional resins, Model 3 features a stable, matte finish that resists sticking to heated substrates and ensures consistent results. Its high pigment stability eliminates the need for frequent mixing, while its water‑washable composition provides safe, eco‑friendly handling—no alcohol or chemical cleaners required. Whether you're fabricating clear aligners or custom appliances, Resinwork® Model 3 is your go‑to solution for dependable, lab‑grade performance.

surgical_guide.name: Surgical Guides
surgical_guide.subTitle: 3D print highly-accurate surgical guides for just a few dollars.
surgical_guide.description: Receive all the clinical benefits of guided surgery with rapid turnaround times and minimal material cost by printing guides in-office. Upload your scan and CBCT data to Resinwork® Cloud Design and receive printable 3D files designed specifically for Resinwork® Pro. 3D print the surgical guide in as little as 30 minutes. Immediately insert surgical guide sleeves post-print for increased precision, then post‑process and sterilize. Resinwork® Surgical Guide 2 resin features excellent mechanical properties and can be sterilized using standard autoclave protocols without affecting dimensional accuracy.

intro.title: Resin Manufacturing.
paragraphs: We specialise in the research, development, pilot-scale validation, and contract manufacturing of advanced 3D printing resins for global markets. With strong capabilities in formulation science, process optimisation, and scalable manufacturing, we help customers transform concepts into reliable, high-performance resin systems.
Our services cover custom resin development, pilot batch production, scale-up support, and OEM/private label manufacturing — with a strong focus on consistency, quality, and confidentiality.

From early-stage R&D to commercial production, we partner with companies worldwide to develop innovative resin solutions tailored to evolving additive manufacturing technologies and chemistry requirements.

formulation.title: Formulation Science
formulation.desc: In-house chemistry expertise across photopolymer systems, cure kinetics, and additive packages for dental, casting, and functional resins.

optimisation.title: Process Optimisation
optimisation.desc: Systematic scale-up from lab-bench to pilot to commercial — with full process documentation and transfer support for your production team.

scalable.title: Scalable Manufacturing
scalable.desc: Dual facilities in India and Germany enable flexible production from pilot quantities to full commercial volumes with consistent quality across batches.

confidentiality.title: Confidentiality & IP Protection
confidentiality.desc: NDA-protected from first contact. Your formulation details, brand strategy, and commercialisation plans remain fully confidential throughout the engagement.

services.title: What We
services.sub: Six specialised services — individually tailored to where you are in your product journey, from first concept to full commercial rollout.

1.title: Custom Resin Development
1.desc: Bespoke photopolymer formulation developed to your performance specification — viscosity, cure speed, mechanical properties, washability, and colour. Iterative lab development with full IP ownership transfer.

2.title: OEM / Private Label Manufacturing
2.desc: Your brand on our proven resin formulations. We manufacture, fill, and label under your brand name — fully white-label, with no Resinwork branding. Consistency, quality, and complete discretion guaranteed.

3.title: Pilot Batch Production
3.desc: Bridge the gap between lab prototype and commercial scale. We run pilot batches, validate performance against specification, and generate all necessary QC and approval documentation.

4.title: Scale-Up Support
4.desc: Systematic transfer from lab-bench to production scale. We manage process optimisation, parameter documentation, and yield validation — ensuring commercial batches perform identically to lab samples.

5.title: Regulatory Documentation
5.desc: Complete TDS, SDS/MSDS, REACH, and RoHS documentation prepared by our in-house technical team. Adapted for each destination market and regulatory environment.

6.title: Packaging & Export
6.desc: UN-certified hazmat-compliant filling and packaging. We manage cartridge, bottle, and bulk drum formats — plus full export documentation for global distribution across 65+ countries.

rows.title: In-House R&D
rows.head: What this means
rows.body: Every formulation is developed in our own laboratories in Germany and India. No outsourcing — complete IP ownership, rapid iteration, and direct access to our chemists throughout the engagement.

rows.title: Scalable Mfg
rows.head: What this means
rows.body: Dual manufacturing facilities in India (primary) and Germany (European) allow flexible production — from pilot quantities through to full commercial volumes — with consistent batch quality at every scale.

rows.title: Full Traceability
rows.head: What this means
rows.body: Batch-controlled production with complete raw material traceability from supplier to finished product. Every commercial batch is backed by certificates of analysis, QC data, and full documentation.

rows.title: 15+ Years Chem
rows.head: What this means
rows.body: 15+ years in speciality chemical manufacturing means we understand industrial chemistry, not just resin formulation. Process discipline, raw material expertise, and regulatory knowledge built over time.

rows.title: Global Reach
rows.head: What this means
